class: Factually supported qualifications substitute for employer or role motivation
symptom: Why do you want to work at Palantir was filled with resume accomplishments and a statement that the work matched prior experience, without a concrete reason to choose the employer or role.
root_cause: The drafting instruction asked for reasons but did not distinguish motivation from qualification. The content review described experience and factual question coverage without explicit motivation acceptance criteria, allowing a factually supported resume summary to pass.
why_tests_missed: Review tests covered factual support, technical experience and fitted limits, but did not exercise an incomplete motivation answer followed by a posting-grounded repair.
fix: Clarify why-answer generation and the existing content review: qualifications alone are incomplete for employer/role motivation. Require a concrete posting-backed reason and relevant supported experience; prohibit invented admiration, products, mission, impact or preferences. Accept a role-specific reason when no broader company facts are supplied. Preserve the existing bounded rewrite and fail-closed approval gate without extra model calls.
prevention: Validate coverage according to question intent as well as factuality. Scripted provider tests verify prompt and retry contracts; live model answer quality and the original application outcome remain unverified.
